title: TraceQL property generator's root-marker sentinel hid real descendant matches from its own oracle
summary: The chDB-backed TraceQL property oracle reported a deterministic divergence on { resource.service.name = "web" } >> { resource.service.name = "batch" }: cerberus returned no series where the oracle expected the trace-level {} result. The root cause was NOT a cerberus lowering bug: gen.TraceQLDataset marked a root span with the sentinel "0000000000000000" while OTel-CH's real convention is an EMPTY ParentSpanId for a root, so cerberus's structural rootedness walk correctly treated every generated chain as orphaned (removing all child/descendant matches) while the in-memory reference oracle kept naively following the sentinel's parent links anyway. Production internal/traceql structural-relation lowering was correct throughout; the property harness's own generator was producing OTel-CH-invalid input.
root_cause_subsystem: test/property/gen (TraceQLDataset's span-chain root-marker sentinel) — NOT internal/traceql, whose descendant-relation lowering PR #2244's own root-cause note confirms was correct throughout.
discovery_narrative: Found by the chDB-backed Rapid property sweep (go test -tags chdb -run '^TestTraceQL_Property$' ./test/property) during its canonical coverage lane, which persisted a failing counterexample to test/property/testdata/rapid/TestTraceQL_Property/TestTraceQL_Property-20260816143957-2846777.fail per the issue's own repro section.
seed_provenance_note: The original Rapid failfile named in issue #2241 (test/property/testdata/rapid/TestTraceQL_Property/TestTraceQL_Property-20260816143957-2846777.fail) has since rotated out of the tree — test/property/testdata does not exist in the current checkout. This record binds instead to TestTraceQLDescendantPropertyMatch, the permanent deterministic regression PR #2244 added (test/property/traceql_test.go) as a hand-authored, stable two-span reconstruction of the same descendant shape; it is a reconstructed minimal case, not the original seed file.
mutation_class_rationale: The wrong literal sentinel ("0000000000000000") stood in for the correct root convention (empty string), and no gremlins operator mutates a string-literal sentinel. This is also test-only code (test/property/gen), categorically outside gremlins' phased rollout (internal/** only per .gremlins.yaml), so no gremlins mutant could ever have exercised this defect regardless of operator vocabulary.

contracts.locator_detail: TestTraceQLDescendantPropertyMatch (lines 143-180) seeds a two-span otel_traces chain — root span '0102...0708' with empty ParentSpanId, child span '1112...1718' with ParentSpanId set to the root's SpanId — and asserts { resource.service.name = "web" } >> { resource.service.name = "batch" } answers exactly one trace-level empty-label row.
